description: This file defines a Spring Batch ItemReader component for reading aggregated journal entry data from a database, specifically for a job related to journal entry aggregation. It sets up SQL queries, maps database rows to data objects, and configures step execution context parameters.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobReader
classes.description: A Spring Batch ItemReader that retrieves and maps journal entry aggregation data from the database for a specific date range, configured at runtime during job step execution.

methods.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the reader with data source based on tenant context and sets the SQL to be executed.

methods.name: beforeStep
methods.description: Lifecycle method called before step execution; retrieves date range from job execution context and sets parameters for the SQL query.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a database row from the ResultSet into a JournalEntryAggregationSummaryData object.

methods.name: buildAggregationQuery
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query string used to aggregate journal entries from various related tables.
